unresolvedReferences.description: Liu Feng's birth father, the Kou of the Marquis of Luo, and his Liu maternal kin are unnamed.
English 'marquis of Yuan Village' for 員鄉侯; Shen Dan promotion dated with 219 context.
Allusive figures (伊、呂、桓、文) appear as single characters; only Yi Yin and Lü Wang extracted from English candidates.
English renders 霄 as 'Xia'; standard reading is Xiao.
Meng Da's Wei appointments follow Cao Pi's 220 accession but are undated.
Variant reading 真鄉侯 for Shen Yi's marquisate.
Liu Feng's forced suicide (220) is not dated in the text.
Huangchu and Taihe era references are period-only; no year assigned.
Liu Bei's uncle named only 敬; English omits the name.
Peng Yang's execution at 37 is undated.
English 'Chang River regiment' for 長水校尉 (Changshui).
Zhuge Liang's death (234) is not dated in the text.
三苗 (Sanmiao) treated as a collective, not a person; 有虞 extracted as Shun.
English 'general of the household' for 裨將軍.
Ma Liang's brothers unnamed.
English 'marquis of Dou village' for 都鄉侯 (Duxiang).
Li Ping's deposition follows the 231 campaign but is not explicitly dated.
Twenty-two co-signers listed with acting offices; only principal office and marquisate recorded per person.
Liu Bei's death in 223 implied, not stated.
English 'Zhu commandery' for 朱提 (Zhuti).
太后 identified as Empress Dowager Wu (not named in text).
English 'Ji Valley' for 北谷口.
English 'Nan Zheng'/'Yang Creek' for 南鄭/陽谿.
Zhuge Liang's death (autumn 234) is not dated within the unit.
English 'Wuzhang Plain' for 谷口.
Yang Yi's suicide (235) undated in text.
德行楊君 rendered 'Lord Yang' as epithet of Yang Lü.
